DECLARATION OF COVENANTS, CONDITIONS, AND RESTRICTIONS
For
PINECREST MEADOWS HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION
Adopted by Board Resolution - March 15, 2022
Effective - April 1, 2022
ARTICLE I - PURPOSE AND AUTHORITY
Section 1.1 - Purpose
These Covenants, Conditions, and Restrictions ("CC&Rs") are adopted for the protection,
enhancement, preservation, and maintenance of property values, community aesthetics,
and welfare within the Pinecrest Meadows subdivision ("the Community").
Section 1.2 - Authority
This Declaration is enacted pursuant to applicable state statutes governing common-
interest communities and forms a legally binding servitude running with all Lots within the
Community.
Section 1.3 - Applicability
All owners, lessees, occupants, and successors shall be bound by and shall comply with
these CC&Rs.
ARTICLE II - ASSESSMENTS, DUES, AND DELINQUENCIES
Section 2.1 - Regular Assessments
Each Lot is subject to annual assessments ("HOA Dues") for common expenses. The
annual assessment is $1,200.00 USD, billed in four equal quarterly installments of
$300.00, payable on the 1st of January, April, July, and October ("Due Date").
Section 2.2 - Late Fees and Interest
A $35.00 Late Fee shall be applied when payment is not received within 15 days after the
Due Date ("Late Fee Due Date"). If the balance remains unpaid 30 days after the Due
Date, interest shall accrue at 1.5% per month on the outstanding amount.
Section 2.3 - Delinquency Enforcement
Unpaid assessments constitute a continuing lien on the Lot and may be subject to legal
collection, lien filing, attorney fees, and suspension of voting rights and amenities.
Section 2.4 - Returned Payments
A $25.00 fee shall be charged for returned or rejected payments.
ARTICLE III - ARCHITECTURAL CONTROL & EXTERIOR MODIFICATIONS
Section 3.1 - Architectural Review Requirement
No exterior construction, alteration, painting, fencing, structural addition, or modification
shall commence until a written application is approved by the Architectural Review
Committee ("ARC").
Section 3.2 - Submission Requirements
Applications shall include plans, dimensions, materials, colors, proposed contractors, and
timelines. The ARC shall approve or deny within 30 days.
Section 3.3 - Prohibited or Restricted Modifications
Unless expressly approved, the following are prohibited:
(a) Chain-link or wire fencing in front yards;
(b) Exterior colors outside the approved palette;
(c) Satellite dishes visible from the street;
(d) Roofing materials not matching existing standards;
(e) Window AC units visible from the front elevation.
Section 3.4 - Non-Compliance
Unapproved exterior work may be ordered paused or removed at the owner's cost.
ARTICLE IV - LANDSCAPE & PROPERTY MAINTENANCE
Section 4.1 - Lawn Standards
Owners shall maintain lawns to a height not exceeding five (5) inches, remove weeds, trim
shrubs, and keep all visible areas free of debris and stored materials.
Section 4.2 - Seasonal Requirements
Leaves shall be removed during fall season; dead trees or hazardous limbs must be
removed upon notice.
Section 4.3 — Violation & Remedy
Upon violation, a written notice will be issued providing ten (10) days to cure. Failure to
cure permits the HOA to correct the condition and charge the owner plus a $50
administrative fee.
ARTICLE V - USE & OCCUPANCY RESTRICTIONS
Section 5.1 — Parking and Vehicles
No boats, RVs, trailers, or commercial vehicles shall be parked in driveways or streets for
more than 48 consecutive hours without approval. Inoperable vehicles must be stored in a
garage.
Section 5.2 - Pets and Nuisances
Domestic pets are permitted. Excessive noise, aggressive behavior, or failure to remove
animal waste constitutes a violation. Livestock and breeding operations are prohibited.
Section 5.3 - Noise and Conduct
No owner shall create excessive noise or nuisance disturbing neighboring properties. Quiet
hours are enforced daily between 10:00 PM and 7:00 AM.
Section 5.4 - Trash and Recycling
Bins shall be stored out of street view except on collection days. Bulk items require special
arrangement.
Section 5.5 - Leasing and Rentals
Leases must be a minimum of 30 days. Short-term rentals (Airbnb/VRBO) are prohibited.
Owners must provide the HOA with tenant contact information within 7 days of occupancy.
ARTICLE VI — ENFORCEMENT, FINES, AND REMEDIES
Section 6.1 — Enforcement Powers
The Association may enforce these CC&Rs by written notice, fines, amenity suspension,
self-help remedies, liens, or legal action.
Section 6.2 - Fines
Fines may be imposed for continuing or repeated violations. Fines shall accrue per day if
violations remain uncured after notice.
Section 6.3 — Legal Recourse
The Association may recover attorney fees, costs, and interest in any enforcement action.
ARTICLE VII - AMENDMENTS AND SEVERABILITY
Section 7.1 - Amendments
These CC&Rs may be amended by majority Board approval and ratification by 67% of
owners in good standing.
Section 7.2 - Severability
If any provision is held invalid, the remainder of the CC&Rs remain enforceable.
CERTIFICATION
Approved and adopted by the Board of Directors of Pinecrest Meadows Homeowners
Association on March 15, 2022, to be effective April 1, 2022.
- Board of Directors, Pinecrest Meadows HOA
